results.objective: Verify valid new user registration redirects to / and displays username in navbar.
results.preconditions: Fresh isolated Flask server and browser with cleared cookies.
results.steps:
1. Open /register.
2. Enter unique valid username and 'ValidPass123'.
3. Click Register and wait for redirect.
results.expected: Redirects to '/', renders 'My Tasks', and shows username in .nav-user.
results.actual: Redirected to '/', displayed 'My Tasks' and nav username.

results.objective: Verify blank and special-character usernames are rejected on /register.
results.preconditions: Browser on /register with cleared cookies.
results.steps:
1. Open /register.
2. Submit blank or invalid-char username.
3. Verify error banner and URL.
results.expected: Stays on /register and shows '3-20 characters' validation error.
results.actual: All 4 invalid inputs blocked on /register with validation message.

results.objective: Verify username lengths 2 & 21 fail while 3, 4, 19 & 20 chars succeed.
results.preconditions: Browser on /register with unique generated test usernames per length.
results.steps:
1. Open /register.
2. Submit generated username of target length.
3. Check redirect or error text.
results.expected: 2 & 21 chars stay on /register with error; 3, 4, 19 & 20 chars redirect to '/'.
results.actual: All 6 parametrized boundary lengths matched expected pass/fail outcomes.

results.objective: Verify 3-char and 7-char passwords fail while 9-char passwords succeed.
results.preconditions: Browser on /register with unique valid username.
results.steps:
1. Submit 'abc' and 'Abc1234' on /register.
2. Submit 'Abc123456' with valid username.
results.expected: 3 & 7 chars rejected with 'at least 8'; 9 chars redirects to '/'.
results.actual: 3 & 7 char passwords rejected; 9 char password redirected to '/'.

results.objective: Regression guard for DEF-001/DEF-WB-001: 8-char spec minimum must succeed.
results.preconditions: Browser on /register with unique valid username.
results.steps:
1. Open /register.
2. Enter valid username and 8-char password 'Pass1234'.
3. Click Register.
results.expected: Registration succeeds and redirects to '/'.
results.actual: AssertionError: DEF-001/DEF-WB-001 still open: 8-char password 'Pass1234' rejected on /register

results.objective: Verify all 4 login decision table rules and post-logout route blocking.
results.preconditions: Registered user 'dtusr_<uuid>' logged out.
results.steps:
1. Test wrong password, wrong user, and both wrong on /login.
2. Login with valid pair.
3. Click Log out and request '/'.
results.expected: 3 invalid combos show error; valid login opens '/'; logout blocks '/'.
results.actual: All 4 decision-table rules and post-logout /login redirect passed.

results.objective: Verify creating, editing (title, description, category, due date), and cancelling edits.
results.preconditions: Authenticated user logged in via Web UI.
results.test_data: title='Selenium Draft Task' -> 'Selenium Edited Task', cat='Study'->'Work', desc='Updated UI desc', due=+8d
results.steps:
1. Create task via /tasks/new.
2. Click Edit and update all 4 fields.
3. Open Edit again and click Cancel.
results.expected: Updated fields persist in table row; Cancel returns to '/' without overwriting.
results.actual: Created, edited all fields (title/desc/category/due_date), and Cancel preserved row.

results.objective: Verify title search box q, category dropdown, and status dropdown (Open/Done).
results.preconditions: User owns 'Alpha Study Notes' (Study, Open) and 'Beta Work Report' (Work, Done).
results.steps:
1. Filter by q='Alpha'.
2. Reset and filter category='Work'.
3. Filter status='Done' then status='Open'.
results.expected: Each filter isolates only its matching task row.
results.actual: Search q, category dropdown, and Done/Open status filters each returned exact rows.

results.objective: Verify clicking the status circle toggles Open -> Done -> Open.
results.preconditions: User owns an Open task due in +5 days.
results.steps:
1. Click check button on Open task.
2. Verify 'done' class and 'Done' badge.
3. Click check button again.
results.expected: Row toggles Done <-> Upcoming cleanly.
results.actual: Toggled Open -> Done ('Done' badge) and Done -> Open ('Upcoming' badge).

results.objective: Verify Delete triggers JS confirm dialog; dismiss preserves task and accept deletes it.
results.preconditions: User owns 'Task To Delete' on My Tasks.
results.test_data: title='Task To Delete', confirm alert dismiss then accept
results.steps:
1. Click Delete and dismiss confirm alert.
2. Verify task stays.
3. Click Delete and accept alert.
results.expected: Dismiss keeps row; accept removes task and shows empty-state text.
results.actual: JS confirm dialog appeared; dismiss kept row and accept deleted it cleanly.

results.objective: Verify Dashboard summary cards accurately count overdue, due soon, open, and completed tasks.
results.preconditions: Authenticated user creates 3 tasks (overdue -2d, due soon +1d, completed +4d).
results.test_data: Past Due (-2d), Due Soon (+1d), Completed (+4d toggled Done)
results.steps:
1. Create 3 tasks and mark 1 Done.
2. Save task-list screenshot.
3. Open /dashboard, save screenshot, check 5 cards.
results.expected: Dashboard displays Total=3, Open=2, Overdue=1, Due Soon=1, Completed (last 7 days)=1.
results.actual: All 5 Dashboard cards matched (3/2/1/1/1) and screenshots captured.

results.objective: Verify Overdue, Due Soon (1 & 2 days), Upcoming (3 days), and No due date badges.
results.preconditions: Authenticated user on /tasks/new.
results.steps:
1. Create 5 tasks with target due-date offsets.
2. Inspect rendered urgency badge per row on '/'.
results.expected: Badges show Overdue, Due Soon, Due Soon, Upcoming, and No due date.
results.actual: All 5 due-date boundary badges rendered as specified.

results.objective: Regression guard for DEF-002/DEF-WB-002: task due today must show 'Due Today'.
results.preconditions: Authenticated user logged in via Web UI.
results.steps:
1. Create task with due_date set to today.
2. Read badge text on '/'.
results.expected: Urgency badge reads 'Due Today'.
results.actual: AssertionError: DEF-002/DEF-WB-002 still open: due today rendered as 'Overdue'

results.objective: Regression guard for DEF-SP-005: HTML markup in task title must not render live DOM nodes.
results.preconditions: Authenticated user on /tasks/new.
results.steps:
1. Create task with HTML <span> tag.
2. Query DOM by ID 'stqa-xss-injected' on '/'.
results.expected: 0 matching live DOM elements (escaped as text).
results.actual: AssertionError: DEF-SP-005 still open: |safe in index.html rendered unescaped HTML element in DOM

results.objective: Verify protected Web routes redirect (302) and REST API routes return 401 without session.
results.preconditions: Isolated Flask subprocess running; client holds no session cookie.
results.steps:
1. GET Web routes without redirects.
2. GET/POST protected /api/* routes without cookies.
results.expected: Web routes return 302 to /login; API routes return 401.
results.actual: Web routes returned 302; all tested API routes returned 401.

results.objective: Verify /api/login (401/200), blank-title 400, CRUD lifecycle, filters, reopen done=False, 404, and UI parity.
results.preconditions: Isolated Flask subprocess running; unique registered test user.
results.test_data: title='API Regression Task', category_id=1, bad title='   ', missing id=999999, PUT done=True->False
results.steps:
1. Check /api/login 401 & 200.
2. Check blank title 400 & create task.
3. Filter, check UI parity, check 404, toggle done True->False, delete & confirm removal.
results.expected: All HTTP status codes, JSON fields, completed_at reset, and Web UI visibility match spec.
results.actual: Login 401/200, blank-title 400, CRUD, filters, completed_at reset, 404, and UI parity passed.

results.objective: Verify GET /api/categories and all 5 GET /api/dashboard JSON counters.
results.preconditions: Isolated Flask subprocess running; user with past (-1d), soon (+1d), and completed tasks.
results.test_data: GET /api/categories; 3 seeded API tasks (1 overdue, 1 due_soon, 1 done)
results.steps:
1. GET /api/categories.
2. Create 3 tasks and mark 1 done.
3. GET /api/dashboard and compare all 5 keys.
results.expected: 4 default categories returned; dashboard JSON equals {total:3, open:2, overdue:1, due_soon:1, completed_this_week:1}.
results.actual: Categories and all 5 /api/dashboard JSON counters matched exactly.

results.objective: Regression guard for DEF-WB-003: exact 7-day completion and same-second timestamp must count.
results.preconditions: Pure unit call to helpers.completed_in_last_n_days(); no Flask server or SQLite DB required.
results.steps:
1. Import helpers.
2. Call completed_in_last_n_days('2026-11-20 12:00:00', n=7, now=now).
3. Call with same-second string.
results.expected: Both boundary calls return True.
results.actual: AssertionError: DEF-WB-003 still open: completed_in_last_n_days uses '< n' instead of '<= n'

results.objective: Regression guard for DEF-SP-001/DEF-API-003: duplicate username registration must fail.
results.preconditions: Isolated Flask subprocess running; unique username already registered once.
results.steps:
1. POST /api/register first time.
2. POST /api/register second time with same username.
results.expected: Second call returns HTTP 400 or 409.
results.actual: AssertionError: DEF-SP-001/DEF-API-003 still open: duplicate register returned 201

results.objective: Regression guard for DEF-SP-009/DEF-API-001: invalid due_date must return HTTP 400.
results.preconditions: Authenticated API session.
results.steps:
1. POST /api/tasks with impossible calendar date '2026-02-30'.
2. Assert HTTP 400.
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request returned without 500 error.
results.actual: AssertionError: DEF-SP-009/DEF-API-001 still open: bad due_date returned HTTP 500

results.objective: Regression guard for DEF-SP-004: SQLi in GET /api/tasks?q= must not leak User B tasks.
results.preconditions: Two authenticated API users (User A and User B) owning distinct tasks.
results.test_data: q="x%' OR title = 'B Private Task' OR 'a' = 'b"
results.steps:
1. Create User A and User B tasks.
2. Call GET /api/tasks?q=<payload> as User A.
3. Inspect JSON titles.
results.expected: HTTP 200 returned with 0 tasks belonging to User B.
results.actual: AssertionError: DEF-SP-004 still open: SQLi leaked cross-user task ['B Private Task']

results.objective: Regression guard for DEF-SP-013: User B cannot delete User A's task; GET/PUT stay isolated.
results.preconditions: User A owns target task; User B is a separate authenticated user.
results.test_data: User B sends GET, PUT, and DELETE /api/tasks/<user_a_tid>
results.steps:
1. Verify User B GET/PUT return 404.
2. Send DELETE as User B.
3. Verify User A task stays intact.
results.expected: User B DELETE returns 403/404 and User A GET returns 200.
results.actual: AssertionError: DEF-SP-013 still open: cross-user DELETE returned 200
